description: Mythos artifact retention policy. Governs cleanup, archival, and protection of system artifacts. Surfaces may declare a single-tier policy (retention + action) OR a generational tiers[] policy (hot -> archive -> delete). When a file matches more than one surface key, the most specific key (deepest path, longest match) owns it.

tiers_schema.description: A surface with a tiers[] array uses generational retention. Each tier is { after: <duration>, action: archive|delete }. For a given file the tier with the largest 'after' that is <= the file's age governs; files younger than the smallest 'after' are hot (kept). preserve_latest still exempts the newest file in the surface.

_dev/reports/analysis/visual-plans.description: Generated visual plan artifacts (F1: high-volume, previously swept only by the generic analysis 180d rule). Generational: hot -> archive at 30d -> delete at 120d.

_dev/reports/analysis/convene-runs.description: Convene run bundles (F1: high-volume timestamped subdirs). Generational: hot -> archive at 45d -> delete at 120d.

_dev/reports/analysis/end-session-closeo.description: End-session closeout artifacts (F1: one bundle per session closeout, dominant volume). Directory bundles named end-session-closeout__<scope>__<ts>. Generational: hot -> archive at 30d -> delete at 90d.

_dev/reports/signals.description: Verification and coordination signal files (live surface — only actionable items)

_dev/reports/signals/closed.description: Closed coordination signals — resolved, consumed, or no longer actionable

_handoffs/*/gemini-response-turn-*.json.description: Retry turn artifacts from Gemini AI bridge pipeline

_dev/reports/audit.description: Timestamped project and framework audit reports

_dev/reports/analysis.description: Explicitly authored decision memos and analysis documents
